about: Every dataset Localio uses. The pipeline publishes this in wards.geojson (meta.sources) and fills the OpenStreetMap dates from the cached files, so a refresh updates them. Confidence is Localio's own assessment; the note says why.

sources.use: Ward boundaries, PMC ward titles, 2012 voter rolls
sources.notes: Official boundaries, but PMC redrew its wards in 2017 and absorbed 34 villages in 2017-2021; outlets in those villages fall outside every ward.

sources.dataset_name: Census 2011 population totals for PMC and PCMC
sources.use: Residents per ward (PMC shared by 2012 voter rolls, PCMC shared equally)
sources.coverage: Both corporations; no ward-level count, so each ward gets a share
sources.update_frequency: Decennial; no newer ward-level totals are used
sources.notes: Fifteen years old, and PCMC has no voter roll, so its residents per km2 mostly reflect ward size.

sources.dataset_name: Food and drink places (cafe, fast_food, restaurant, bakery, ice_cream) via the Overpass API
sources.use: Outlet counts, competition, eating-out density, menu mix
sources.coverage: Pune and PCMC bounding box; 40 of 140 wards have 10 or more outlets mapped
sources.update_frequency: On demand: docker compose run --rm osm --refresh
sources.notes: Current, but OpenStreetMap misses outlets, most of all in Pimpri-Chinchwad: 'none mapped' is not 'none there'.

sources.dataset_name: Offices, colleges, stations and place names via the Overpass API
sources.use: Daytime draw, ward place names, search
sources.update_frequency: On demand: docker compose run --rm osm --refresh
sources.notes: Offices are anything tagged office=*; colleges are amenity=college or university; stations are rail stations and halts, metro stations and bus stations.

sources.dataset_name: Pune Retail MarketBeat Q2 2026: prime high-street rents
sources.use: Rent tiers for ten Pune high streets and the wards they run through
sources.coverage: 10 streets; 17 wards sit on one, the other 123 take their zone's tier
sources.notes: Prime ground-floor asking rents; a side street will be cheaper.

sources.dataset_name: Pune shop listings for rent (first page)
sources.use: Typical rent per sq ft (the median of 25 listings)
sources.notes: A small sample of asking rents, not agreed rents.

sources.dataset_name: Restaurant guides: outlet size and healthy rent share
sources.use: Default shop size; the 8-15% rent-to-sales band behind 'sales needed'
sources.coverage: Industry rule of thumb for Indian cafes and QSRs
sources.notes: A planning benchmark, not a measurement of Pune outlets.
